sam: hitting a leak when cancelling streaming responses in the py SDK. generator.__anext__ stops but socket stays open and we see 1-2 background tasks pile up over time. repro in prod-ish load.

sam: minimal repro:
```
async def stream():
    async for chunk in client.stream("/v1/generate", {"prompt": "x"}):
        yield chunk

# consumer
agen = stream()
await agen.__anext__()
await agen.aclose()
# socket stays open (uvloop) and process fd count grows
```

sam: this looks similar to an aclose/finalizer ordering bug but i can't get a deterministic small repro. seen on 3.11, httpx+uvloop.

emily: interesting — i saw something like this where auth retry triggered a reconnect while aclose was in-flight, leaving the socket fd referenced by a background reconnect coroutine. could the retry middleware be racing with generator cleanup? :thinking:

nishant: possible. our retry flow currently does an auth refresh + retry on 401 and spawns a small background reconnect task for streaming clients. if aclose races with that, we'd lose the reference chain and GC won't cancel the task properly.

liz: also check types — our streaming helper returns AsyncIterator[str] in the stubs but yields Token objects in runtime, so consumer code that tries to aclose() via contextmanager might not be closing the underlying client stream correctly. small mismatch but can cause callers to misuse.

sam: good call. my consumer is closing the generator but not the underlying httpx.AsyncClient. i thought client.stream() owned the transport and would close it on aclose.

nishant: design note: stream() should be a context manager-providing async generator so that `async with client.stream(...) as s:` ensures transport lifecycle. currently we rely on generator.finalizer+__anext__/aclose which is fragile.

piotr: short-term patch suggestion:
- ensure streaming retry never spawns detached tasks; return a cancellable task handle
- add explicit async context manager wrapper on top of generator
- add a unit test that cancels during auth refresh path

nishant: agreed. i'll open a small PR for the wrapper + test. leaving retry backpressure fix for a follow-up.

liz: will add typing changes in the stub to AsyncIterator[Token] and update docs. also add a small snippet in examples/streaming showing `async with` usage.

sam: repro gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/abc123 (contains a tiny server + client script that reproduces fd leak in ~30s under loop)

piotr: thanks — i'll pick this up. assign to nishant/piotr. adding issue: #4567 and linking PR when ready. :white_check_mark:

devex-bot: CI failure on main: test_stream_cancel_during_401 (flaky) — tagging @nishant

nishant: ack, will prioritize flaky test + patch. anyone else hit this in customer reports? sam: couple of support tickets referencing high fd count for streaming services.

emily: also re: onboarding friction — sample app in repo uses the old iterator pattern, we should update the quickstarts to recommend `async with` to avoid this class of leaks. can we include in the PR?

piotr: yes, include doc + changelog entry. leave a note to backport to 0.23.x as it's a resource leak.

sam: thanks all, i can help validate the fix on our side once PR is up. will check in after nishant/PR lands.

piotr: closing loop — PR #7890 opened with wrapper + test, marking as draft. will request review from liz + emily. once green, we'll ship patch and create a follow-up for retry detach fix.

sam: awesome — thanks! :pray:
